findings.claim: Vertiv Q4 2025 backlog about $15.0B, up 109% y/y, book-to-bill ~2.9x, TTM organic orders up ~81%; 2026 organic sales growth guided 27-29%.

Eaton $340M SC transformer plant production expected 2027; Siemens Energy Charlotte plant early 2027; GE Vernova Vietnam April 2027; Hitachi Energy South Boston 2028; analysts say meaningful relief not until after 2027; one view (Power Magazine) argues procurement practices, not capacity, are the bottleneck.
findings.source: Search summary of grid equipment shortage articles (Power Magazine, ecmag, greentechlead)

findings.claim: Omdia: data center cooling growth constrained by production capacity (e.g. CDUs) rather than lack of demand; Bloomberg Intelligence projects DC infrastructure equipment from $46B (2024) to $73B (2028).
findings.source: Omdia via Data Center Knowledge; Bloomberg Intelligence

findings.claim: Simply Wall St flags rising customer concentration and possible in-house data center builds by large customers at Vertiv.
Vertiv and Eaton posted record backlogs and raised guidance on Q2 2026 calls; Vertiv deferred revenue rose; Electrical Americas DC orders ~+65%.
